about.title: My Background
about.description:
Hi, I’m Lucas — a Project Manager with a background in software engineering and a career built around technology, Agile, and people leadership. Since starting my career in 2018, I’ve grown from an intern and software engineer into roles as Scrum Master, Agile leader, and now Project Manager, working with multidisciplinary teams and global clients. 
 What I enjoy most is bringing people together, turning complex challenges into clear plans, and helping teams deliver meaningful results. I combine technical knowledge, Agile practices, and project management to connect people, strategy, and execution. 
 With an MBA in Project Management and a strong foundation in Agile and technology, I’m passionate about creating impact through better teams, smarter processes, and effective delivery.
